full_prompt_en: A square fantasy adventure illustration shows a small goggle wearing rider steering a green scaled sea creature through foaming waves. The rider occupies the upper left center, leaning forward in a dark sage outfit with segmented sleeves, gloves, belts, and a pack. Blond hair streams backward under a pair of large round goggles, and a reddish scarf or cape curls into the wind behind the shoulders. Both hands hold taut reins that run diagonally toward the creature's head at the lower right. The creature has a round staring eye, a broad scaly forehead, a long orange whisker, and a tooth filled mouth partly open toward the right edge. Large coral orange fins rise from its back and sweep across the left and lower sides of the composition. Around them, green gray waves break into thick pale foam, and curling storm clouds crowd the distant sky. Small orange shapes in the background repeat the warm fins and keep the pale sea from feeling flat. The scene is packed edge to edge, with interlocking curves of water, cloud, fin, and harness. Fine ink contours delineate every scale, strap, and curl; layered watercolor or gouache color supplies muted green, cream, coral, and earthy brown. Diffuse storm light illuminates the foamy ridges and rider's hair, while deeper olive shadow sits under the creature and in the troughs. The image feels brisk, playful, and adventurous, its rich detail held together by strong diagonal motion.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形奇幻冒险插画描绘一名戴护目镜的小骑手驾着绿色鳞片海兽穿过翻涌浪花。骑手占据左上中央，身体前倾，穿深鼠尾草绿服装、分节袖套、手套、腰带与背包。金发从大圆护目镜下向后飞扬，红褐围巾或披风在肩后迎风卷起。双手握紧缰绳，绳索斜向通往右下的海兽头部。海兽有圆瞪眼、宽大鳞片额头、橙色长须，张开的齿状嘴朝向右边缘。巨大的珊瑚橙色鳍从背上升起，横扫构图左侧和下方。四周绿灰浪花碎成厚厚浅色泡沫，卷曲风暴云挤满远天。背景小橙形呼应暖色鱼鳍，使浅色海面不显平淡。场景边到边拥挤，水、云、鳍和鞍具的曲线互相咬合。细墨线界定每片鳞、背带和卷曲；层叠水彩或水粉颜色提供低饱和绿、奶油白、珊瑚和土棕。漫射风暴光照亮泡沫脊线和骑手头发，海兽下方与浪谷里留有深橄榄影。图像迅捷、活泼而充满冒险感，丰富细节由强烈斜向运动收束。
style_prompt_en: Fantasy adventure illustration uses dense fine contours and layered muted color to organize vigorous diagonal motion. Rounded textured forms interlock with curling ribbons and sharply pointed accents, filling nearly every corner of the frame. Sage green, deep olive, cream, coral orange, and earthy brown establish a balanced cool warm palette. Small repeated marks build granular surfaces, while broad curved strokes shape foaming or cloudlike areas. Precise linear detail remains readable despite the crowded composition because one strong diagonal carries the eye through it. Diffuse light picks out pale ridges and raised edges; deeper green shadow collects in troughs and beneath overlaps. Slightly aged pigment and ink texture keep the finish handmade rather than glossy. The image feels playful, kinetic, and intricately imagined, with graphic clarity inside an exuberant flow.
style_prompt_zh: 奇幻冒险插画用密集细轮廓与层叠低饱和颜色组织强劲斜向运动。圆润有肌理的形体与卷曲带状笔路、尖锐重音互相咬合，几乎填满画框每个角落。鼠尾草绿、深橄榄、奶油白、珊瑚橙和土棕建立冷暖平衡色域。重复小痕构建颗粒表面，宽阔曲线笔触塑出泡沫或云状区域。尽管构图拥挤，精密线性细节仍可读，因为一道强斜线引导视线穿行。漫射光拣出浅色脊线和凸起边缘，深绿影聚在低处及重叠之下。略带陈旧感的颜料与墨线肌理使成品保留手工质感而非光滑。图像活泼、充满动势且想象繁复，狂欢流动里仍有图形清晰度。
